Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3384; motherless, i.e. of unknown maternity:--without mother.
BiblicalUsage: Once, in the portrait of Melchisedec: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually. The word is motherless, of unknown maternity, and the point is not that Melchisedec had no mother but that the record gives him none, so his priesthood has no beginning and no end.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for motherless carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the silence, that the priest with no genealogy is the picture of the priest who lives forever.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
